sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Dazzle with sophistication wearing the Cushion Halo CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women. This stunning ring showcases a brilliant cushion-cut CZ centerpiece surrounded by a sparkling halo, all elegantly set on a lustrous gold-plated band. The timeless design and exceptional sparkle make the Cushion Halo CZ Gold-Plated Ring for Women perfect for elevating any look, whether for daily elegance, special celebrations, or as a treasured gift.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Classic cushion halo design for timeless elegance
✨ Brilliant CZ stones deliver maximum sparkle
✨ Adjustable fit for comfortable all-day wear
✨ Perfect for parties, special occasions, or meaningful gifting
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Premium, durable alloy for lasting quality
🔹 Plating: Rich gold plating for luxurious shine
🔹 Stone Type: Cushion-cut and round cubic zirconia
🔹 Design: Classic halo setting with cushion-cut centerpiece
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable to fit most finger sizes comfortably
🔹 Best Use: Ideal for daily wear, party wear, and special gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
